content: {"praised":["Garbo's performance is understated and emotionally powerful.","Marie Dressler delivers a superb, memorable supporting role.","Director Clarence Brown creates a melancholy, hopeful mood.","The film adapts O'Neill's play with fine writing.","Production quality makes it a classic of American filmmaking."],"criticized":["Film has not aged well, feels dated.","Garbo's dialogue feels archaic, reminiscent of silent era.","Over-the-top performances by some co-stars.","Language and plot are undercooked and corny.","Story feels psychologically implausible to modern audiences."]}
